title: ACM Creativity & Cognition 2027
about: ACM Creativity & Cognition 2027, a virtual conference on 13-16 June 2027 themed 'Creativity and the Unseen', invites papers, pictorials and artworks: abstracts due 19 January 2027, final submissions 25 January 2027 (AoE). Posters, demos and symposia are due 18 March 2027.
